title: Paper trading
subtitle: Simulated books with market fills at last price plus venue fee and slippage. Not real money — informational only.
disclaimer: Paper trading only. Not financial advice. No real money.

books.label: Book
books.name: Name
books.empty: No paper books yet — create one to start.

stress.title: If the market moves
stress.hint: See equity, total P&L, and margin before a drop or rally. Example: BTC −10% and ETH −15%. Nothing is traded.

risk.title: Total exposure
risk.hint: New buys stop once all coins together pass this share of equity. Positions you already hold stay open.

equityChart.title: Performance
equityChart.hint: Cash you add or take out is not part of this line.
equityChart.empty: No equity samples yet — trade or wait for the next snapshot.

trade.title: Spot order ticket
trade.hint: Market fills at last price with paper fee and slippage. Limits/stops rest until triggered. Quote must match book currency (USDT).
trade.riskNeedStop: Enter a stop. The size is this percent of the book, divided by the loss down to that stop.
trade.riskSizesBuy: Sizes the buy from this stop. A market or limit order does not place the stop. Clear the percent to type a size.
trade.riskSizesBracket: Sizes the entry from this stop. The stop is placed with it. Clear the percent to type a size.
trade.riskSizesMargin: Sizes the position from this stop. The stop is placed with the open. Clear the percent to type a size.
trade.reasonHint: Only the clauses you mark are stored. Later reads use those.
trade.reasonFailed: The market read did not load. This order will not store a reason.
trade.reasonBlank: This read has no clauses. This order will not store a reason.
trade.reasonHistoryHint: Each line is a clause you marked, at the kind the live read says now. Still the same means the sell kept that kind. After it left means the kind changed, or the sell left that clause blank. The same close can appear on more than one line, so these lines are not one total.
trade.reasonHistoryNone: No past close stored this reason.

preview.title: Before you place it
preview.rests: This would rest until the price is touched.
preview.exposure: Coins together would be {{pct}} of the book
preview.sized: {{pct}} of the book. The size loses about {{budget}} if the stop fills.
preview.stopNotAttached: This stop only sizes the buy. A market or limit order does not place it.
preview.fromBook: The fill is the average of the visible book.
preview.note: Preview only — nothing was placed. A crypto fill walks the visible book. Equities use a fixed slippage. A size the book cannot hold is not filled. Risk limits block new buys and new margin opens. Sells are not blocked. Not real money.

warnings.blocked: Risk limits would block this order.
warnings.dailyLoss: Today's loss limit is already hit. Deposits and withdrawals are not part of that loss.
warnings.weight: This coin would be over its weight limit.
warnings.exposure: Total exposure would be over the limit.
warnings.borrow: This would pass the borrow limit.
warnings.stopBeyondLiquidation: The stop is past liquidation, so the position would close there first. The loss would not be the stop distance.
warnings.book: The visible book cannot hold this size. Nothing would be filled.

margin.title: Margin ticket
margin.hint: Paper long/short 1–10x. Isolated or cross mode. Not real money.
margin.closeHint: Open size is {{qty}} {{symbol}}. Enter a smaller size to keep the rest open. The stop and take profit stay on what remains.
margin.badCloseQty: Enter a size up to the open position. What remains has to be large enough to keep, or close the whole position.
margin.bracketsHint: Compared with the entry {{entry}}. A long stop sits below it and a long take profit sits above it. A short is the other way around. Clear a price to remove it. The position stays open.
margin.bracketsSuccess: Stop loss and take profit updated
margin.stopWillRemove: This stop will be removed when you save.
margin.takeProfitWillRemove: This take profit will be removed when you save.
margin.badStop: Enter a stop on the correct side of the entry, or remove it. A long stop is below the entry. A short stop is above it.
margin.badTakeProfit: Enter a take profit on the correct side of the entry, or remove it. A long take profit is above the entry. A short take profit is below it.
margin.validation: Symbol, quantity, and leverage (1–10) are required
margin.needLimit: Limit price is required for limit orders

cash.title: Cash
cash.transferReplayed: Same transfer already completed — cash was not moved again

orders.title: Open orders
orders.reasonLeft: The market has left the reason on this order.

situationRecord.title: What your closes made
situationRecord.lead: Each row is one kind stored on the buy. Open a row to list those closes, newest first. The same close can appear on more than one row, so these rows are not one total. Open positions stay on the positions tab. Equities are left out.
situationRecord.empty: No crypto close in this book has a stored read yet.
situationRecord.failed: The close record did not load.
situationRecord.skipped_one: 1 crypto close had no stored read and is left out.
situationRecord.skipped_other: {{count}} crypto closes had no stored read and are left out.

kinds.priceCvd_agrees: Price and futures CVD moving together
kinds.crowd_top_more_long: Top traders more long than the crowd
kinds.crowd_top_more_short: Top traders more short than the crowd
kinds.crowd_even: Top traders and the crowd about even
kinds.size_whale_buy_retail_sell: Large prints buying, smaller prints selling
kinds.size_whale_sell_retail_buy: Large prints selling, smaller prints buying
kinds.size_both_buy: Large and smaller prints both buying
kinds.size_both_sell: Large and smaller prints both selling

situationLeave.title: Did leaving pay
situationLeave.lead: Each row is one kind stored on the buy. Still the same means the sell's read kept that kind. After it left means the kind changed, or the sell's read left that clause blank. A sell with no stored read stays out of both. The same close can appear on more than one row, so these rows are not one total. Open positions stay on the positions tab. Equities are left out.
situationLeave.empty: No crypto close in this book can be compared yet.
situationLeave.failed: The leave record did not load.
situationLeave.skipped_one: 1 crypto close had no stored read on the buy and is left out.
situationLeave.skipped_other: {{count}} crypto closes had no stored read on the buy and are left out.
situationLeave.unreadable_one: 1 crypto close had a stored buy read and no sell read, so it stays out of both groups.
situationLeave.unreadable_other: {{count}} crypto closes had a stored buy read and no sell read, so they stay out of both groups.

moves.title: After fill
moves.hint: Venue price change after the fill. A blank window is not zero, and it is not profit.

rebalance.title: Rebalance results
rebalance.empty: No rebalance runs yet. Run a basket rebalance to store a result.
rebalance.continueSuccess: Continue started from the current book
